description_en: Analyze the execution results of structured data types and generate visualization information.
description_zh: 对结构化数据类型的执行结果进行分析、可视化信息生成
kebab_example: aliyun dataanalysisgbi run-data-result-analysis --workspace-id llm-2v3934xtp49esw64 --sql-data '{"data":["example-string"],"column":["month"]}' --analysis-mode all --request-id FF76AD3F-8B32-567E-819B-0D3738917006 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunDataResultAnalysis

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace ID used for the current request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的阿里云百炼业务空间id
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: A list of specific field names retrieved from the SQL execution result
fields.help_zh: SQL执行结果中，查询到的具体的字段名字列表
fields.name: column

fields.help_en: A list of structured information corresponding to the column names in the SQL execution result. For the detailed structure, refer to the sqlData sample above
fields.help_zh: 与SQL执行结果中的列名对应的结构化信息列表，详细结构可参考上方sqlData的示例
fields.name: data

parameters.name: sql_data

parameters.help_en: The type of visualization to execute. You can generate only a chart or only a text analysis
parameters.help_zh: 当前希望执行的可视化类型，可以只生成图表或只生成文本分析
parameters.name: analysis_mode

parameters.help_en: Request ID. This request ID must be the one returned by the RunSqlGeneration API. If a request ID that has not been executed by RunSqlGeneration is provided, the execution will be denied
parameters.help_zh: 请求id，这里的请求id为RunSqlGeneration接口中执行返回的requestId，若传入未被RunSqlGeneration执行过的requestId，执行会被拒绝
parameters.name: request_id
